title: Watercolor Wine and Grape Clipart
author: Tiana Geo
description:
Watercolor hand painted grape and wine clipart. Perfect for create stickers, birthday invitation, wrapping paper, scrapbooking paper, textile pattern, greeting card, fabric. 
Includes:
-11 watercolor clipart ( 300 DPI, PNG with transparent background, ~2000~4000 px)
Hand painted seamless patterns can be used for wedding invitations, Party Decorations, Greeting Cards, prints, Paper designs, Stickers, web design, Scrapbooking. Perfect for design patterns.
You can print patterns on paper, clothes, bed linen, mugs, textile totes.
